verdict.rationale: Community benchmarking shows Ollama running models at multiple quantization levels (q4_K_M, int4) confirming integer quantization support in practice, but there is no first-party documentation in the pack describing a range of quantization precisions from very low-bit to 8-bit, nor any explicit list of supported quant formats. missing for 10: official docs enumerating supported quant levels (e.g., q2/q3/q4/q5/q8), guidance on choosing quantization for memory savings, and independent benchmarks across the full low-bit to 8-bit range.
